summary.title: Grupo Caballero runs its shareholder register and meetings with Sttok

sections.title: A bit about Grupo Caballero
texts: Grupo Caballero is a family business founded in 1830 in El Puerto de Santa María (Cádiz).

sections.title: Why did they choose us?
texts: 1. For the ease of use of the platform.
2. For the automation of manual tasks.
3. For the management of the shareholder register.
